rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０２６＿００１Helloooo! How's it going?￥Sorry for just barging in!￥What were you up to?
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿００２Your scores last time￥were super good, huh?
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿００４Have you been doing some￥kind of secret training?
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿００６Geez, when did you find￥the time to do all that?!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿００７Maybe I've been slacking￥off lately.＝＠０２６＿００８All right! From now on,￥I'm gonna get fired up!!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿００９Seriously?￥Then that's even￥more amazing!＝＠０２６＿０１０I've gotta work harder!!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿０１１You can't just do the training￥you're good at, you know?
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿０１３But you're seriously amazing!＝＠０２６＿０１４Everyone here is an expert from￥all over the world, and you￥got past them...＝＠０２６＿０１５That's not easy to do!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿０１７"Didn't know"...? Wait, you￥seriously didn't realize?!＝＠０２６＿０１８Unbelievable!＝＠０２６＿０１９No wonder you seemed￥so calm about it!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿０２２Huh...?￥Now I can't remember what I￥came here for!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿０２４I'm gonna follow your example￥and work even harder!!
＊Amane＊＠０２６＿０２５Well, sorry for bugging you￥on your day off.＝＠０２６＿０２６Let's train together￥sometime!!
